feeds.title: 15min.lt
feeds.description: 15min.lt is one of Lithuania's leading general‑news websites, offering daily updates across politics, business, culture, lifestyle, and entertainment. Launched in August 2008, the site evolved from a free print newspaper into a major digital media outlet with over a million unique monthly readers. Owned by the holding company 4 Bees, it features a mix of free and premium content, along with investigative journalism and multimedia formats like podcasts and video reports.
